display_name: Manuscript Submission and Peer-Review Revision Specialist
summary: Runs pre-submission QA, reporting-guideline, consistency and reference checks, anonymization, revision triage, and location-mapped reviewer responses for biomedical manuscripts without claiming experiments, analyses, or edits the authors have not supplied.

skills.description: Runs a multi-lens (contribution, rigor, writing, editor) manuscript review and turns findings into a prioritized revision backlog with gated sprints.
skills._upstream_description: Scrum-inspired paper review, revision, and R&R workflow. Handles docx/tex/md/PDF in English or Chinese. Auto-detects manuscript stage, estimates sprint count, runs multi-lens review (Contribution/Rigor/Writing/Editor), generates prioritized revision backlog, exports MD/DOCX/PDF/HTML reports. Use whe

skills.description: Triages editor and reviewer comments by severity and routes each to experiment, analysis, clarification, restructuring, wording, or bounded rebuttal.
skills._upstream_description: Builds prioritized manuscript revision plans for major or minor revisions by separating comments that require experiments, analyses, clarification, restructuring, or wording changes.

skills.description: Assembles a Word response letter with an editor overview and Comment/Response/Changes-in-Text blocks mapped to page, paragraph, and line.
skills._upstream_description: Helps organize reviewer comments and generate a standardized Word (.docx) response letter that maps each change to its exact location (page/paragraph/line). Use when revising a manuscript, replying to peer-review feedback, or preparing internal review responses.
skills._core_note: core -> supporting (2026-09-10): scientific-collection score taken from POLISH_CHANGELOG (77) per THRESHOLD gate 2; below the core floor of 85.

skills.description: Checks a manuscript against its design-matched reporting guideline (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, TRIPOD, or hybrid) and grades gaps by submission risk.
skills._upstream_description: Checks biomedical manuscripts against reporting guidelines such as CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, and TRIPOD to identify missing or weak reporting elements before submission or revision.

skills.description: Finds sample-size, endpoint, terminology, figure/table/supplement, and conclusion-result contradictions and version drift across manuscript sections.
skills._upstream_description: Checks consistency across title, abstract, methods, results, figures, tables, and supplements to identify internal contradictions and version drift in biomedical manuscripts.

skills.description: Checks that each citation supports the exact claim it is attached to, flagging mismatch, overextension, quote drift, and second-hand citation.
skills._upstream_description: Checks whether manuscript references are accurately matched to claims, appropriately scoped, and not overextended, misquoted, or second-hand cited.

skills.description: Drafts point-by-point replies in accept, explain, rebut, or added-analysis mode, linked to actual manuscript changes and open about unresolved items.
skills._upstream_description: Turns reviewer comments into structured, professional point-by-point responses linked to manuscript revisions, clarifications, rebuttals, and additional analyses.

skills.description: Frames soft-but-firm replies to a sharp or disputed reviewer criticism or an appeal; its script only grades severity and fills a response template.
skills._upstream_description: Use rebuttal letter strategist for academic writing workflows that need structured execution, explicit assumptions, and clear output boundaries.

skills.description: Rewrites defensive or confrontational draft replies into professional academic tone while keeping the author's scientific position.
skills._upstream_description: Polish reviewer-response letters by softening defensive language, preserving factual meaning, and keeping responses professional, concise, and publication-appropriate.

skills.description: Maps manuscript claims to their evidence level and flags causal, mechanistic, validation, and translational inflation with narrower wording.
skills._upstream_description: Calibrates manuscript claim strength so wording matches the actual evidence level, study design, and validation status.

skills.description: Parses reference lists and queries Open Retractions, Crossref, and PubMed by DOI or PMID for retractions and expressions of concern; needs network.
skills._upstream_description: Automatically scan reference lists and check whether cited papers have been retracted, corrected, or flagged; use before submission, review, or evidence synthesis to reduce citation risk.

known_missing.references/example-reports/: sample outputs only; SKILL.md defines the report format

skills.description: Drafts a five-paragraph editor-facing submission cover letter from supplied title, journal, contributions, results, and declarations.
skills._upstream_description: Drafts journal-ready cover letters for manuscript submission. Replaces cover-letter-generator (dropped under THRESHOLD gate 8: assets/cover_letter_template.md and references/guide.md never shipped).

skills.description: Masks author names, institutions, contacts, acknowledgments, and first-person self-citation phrases in .docx/.md/.txt files for double-blind review.
skills._upstream_description: Use blind-review-sanitizer for academic writing workflows that need structured anonymization, explicit assumptions, and clear output boundaries for double-blind submission.

skills.description: Checks figure citation numbering in manuscript text; its bundled script only extracts 'Fig. N' mentions and does not detect orphans or label mismatches.
skills._upstream_description: Use figure reference checker for academic writing workflows that need structured execution, explicit assumptions, and clear output boundaries.

skills.description: Preflights LaTeX or PDF manuscripts for LLM residue, placeholders, AI-as-author, and fabricated or mismatched BibTeX references.
skills._upstream_description: Run a submission-readiness preflight on a manuscript before arXiv upload. skills.description: Proposes sprint, robust, and safe target-journal tiers from topic, abstract, and target impact factor; every metric needs live verification.
skills._upstream_description: Recommend academic journals based on manuscript topic, abstract, and impact factor expectations. Use when the user wants to find suitable journals for their research manuscript, especially when they provide a topic, abstract, and target Impact Factor.
